ModuleDescription: Virtual Desktop and Steam Link face and eye tracking with QFT+ independent gaze, tongue, pupils, personal expression calibration, and movement controls.
UsageInstructions: For Steam Link, enable OSC, eye sharing, and face sharing in SteamVR > Steam Link; set OSC output to 9015. Disable the standalone SteamLink module. Leave VRCFT's VRChat ports unchanged. Virtual Desktop is detected automatically. Start QFT+ for calibrated enhancements.
